summary: Coordinated relocation of research hardware lab with restricted Li-ion battery shipment and temporary secure badge tokens
description:
Issue summary: Research Operations is relocating a small hardware lab (2 racks, 6 workstations, associated peripherals) from SF-HQ Lab B2 to the Seattle R&D satellite. Included in the shipment are two classified Li-ion battery packs (RDW-BATT-0137/0138). These packs exceed standard passenger-compliant watt-hour thresholds and require hazmat handling, EHS signoff, and a courier certified for restricted batteries.

Operational constraints: shipment must arrive before 2026-03-18 for scheduled experiments. Two engineers (E. Ramirez, K. Zhou) need temporary secure access for unpacking and validation for up to four business days. Badge provisioning needs to permit access to Suite 310 and the dedicated equipment closet without granting broader floor access.

Required outcomes: 1) Confirm EHS paperwork and hazmat manifest; 2) Confirm courier with battery-handling certification and provide insured tracking; 3) Provision temporary badge tokens (hardware or time-boxed software badge) with limited scope; 4) Coordinate receiving window and unpacking support with Facilities and Security.
impact: Delay or rejection of battery shipment would block planned experiments and potentially incur extra storage/return costs. Without temporary scoped badges engineers can't complete the verification window, causing downstream experiment schedule slippage.
steps_taken: 2026-03-08: Reporter engaged EHS for battery classification and initial manifest draft (EHS ticket #EHS-3387)
2026-03-09: Facilities packaged equipment on skids; labeled assets RDW-LAB-INV-0491/0492 and fragile items list sent to logistics@redwood.com
2026-03-09: Booked provisional courier quote (AirHazmat Express) and flagged for battery handling certification; courier requested MSDS and cell-level capacity declarations
2026-03-10: Security requested approval for temporary badge token type (hardware fob vs. mobile OTP). Requested minimal privilege role: lab-unpack-sea-3days
2026-03-10: Reporter uploaded shipment manifest and photos to Confluence runbook (see related_confluence_pages)
2026-03-11: Courier flagged battery packs as >160Wh and requested additional export paperwork and insurance confirmation
investigation_notes: AirHazmat flagged discrepancy: RDW-BATT-0138 documentation lists 165Wh per pack; EHS to confirm if packs can be shipped under limited quantity exceptions or must be shipped as UN3480 with full hazmat handling
Customs for Seattle inbound are generally permissive but require detailed invoice and EHS declaration for battery chemistries; recommend including vendor MSDS and inventory serials in airway bill

Temporary badge option analysis: hardware fob can be couriered same day but requires activation by Security Desk; mobile OTP can be activated remotely but some doors require tap (hardware) - Facilities noted an emergency override but prefers tap access for tool closet
Insurance: Standard Redwood courier insurance covers up to $25k; declared asset value is $48k — need to confirm supplemental insurance or courier add-on
resolution: Pending: EHS to confirm UN classification and AirHazmat to confirm handling/insurance add-on. Security to confirm which badge token (fob preferred). Facilities to confirm receiving window (tentative 2026-03-17).
comments: 2026-03-09 - Liam O'Connor (Assignee): Noted courier quote received; asking EHS for definitive Wh per cell. Also looking into temporary fob inventory at SEA site.
2026-03-09 - EHS (E. Hunt): Aisha, send full MSDS and battery test reports. If packs are >160Wh we'll treat as regulated and need UN3480 paperwork.
2026-03-10 - Facilities (M. Chen): We have 2 spare fobs at SEA admin. They'll need activation by Security and assignment to the minimal role. Recommend hardware fobs for tool closet access.
2026-03-11 - AirHazmat Rep: Provided conditional acceptance pending supplemental insurance and UN paperwork. ETA for pickup postponed until documentation is complete.
2026-03-11 - Reporter (Aisha Patel): Uploaded updated manifest and serials to Confluence; requested prioritized EHS turnaround.
